The percentage of the cookies that remained out of the original amount is 144/600*100% = 24%
The final answer is \boxed{24}.

problem_swa: Lillian alienda kutafuta uyoga akiwa na kitabu chake cha kuongoza safari. Alipata uyoga 32 na akatumia kitabu chake cha kuongoza wanyama ili kutambua ni upi uliokuwa wenye sumu na ni upi ambao haukuwa hatari kula. Mwishowe, alikuwa na uyoga 9 ambao angeweza kula kwa usalama kwa chakula cha jioni. Kati ya zile zilizobaki, aliona kiasi kilichokuwa mara mbili ya kile alichokula kuwa chenye sumu, na kikundi kilichobaki hakikuwa na uhakika nacho. Alikuwa na shaka kuhusu uyoga wangapi ambao ulikuwa salama au wenye sumu?
problem_en: Lillian went out to forage for mushrooms with her handy guidebook. She found 32 mushrooms and used her guidebook to identify which ones were poisonous and which were safe to eat. In the end, she had 9 mushrooms she could safely eat for dinner. Of the rest, she identified twice the amount she ate as poisonous, and a remaining bunch she was uncertain about. How many mushrooms was she uncertain were safe or poisonous?
solution:
Lillian found 9 of the mushrooms were safe, so there were 32 - 9 = 23 that she found poisonous or uncertain.
She knew twice the amount she ate were poisonous, so she found 9 * 2 = 18 poisonous mushrooms.
Thus, she was uncertain about 23 - 18 = 5 mushrooms.
The final answer is \boxed{5}.

problem_swa: Mwishowe, John anakuwa mshiriki wa baraza la mahakama. Uchaguzi wa majaji huchukua siku 2. Kesi yenyewe inachukua muda mrefu mara 4 kuliko uteuzi wa jury Ni kesi ngumu. Idadi ya saa zilizotumiwa katika mazungumzo ya baraza la mahakama zililingana na siku 6 kamili. Wao hutumia muda wa saa 16 kila siku wakizungumzia jambo hilo. John hutumia siku ngapi katika kazi ya baraza la mahakama?
problem_en: John ends up serving on jury duty.  Jury selection takes 2 days.  The trial itself lasts 4 times as long as jury selection  It is a complicated trial.  The number of hours spent in jury deliberation was the equivalent of 6 full days.  They spend 16 hours a day in deliberation.  How many days does John spend on jury duty?
solution:
Deliberation ended up taking 6 * 24 = 144 hours
That means they spent 144 / 16 = 9 days in deliberation
The trial lasted 2 * 4 = 8 days
So he spent 2 + 8 + 9 = 19 days on jury duty
The final answer is \boxed{19}.

problem_swa: Inachukua muda wa dakika 20 kwa John kwenda chooni mara 8. Ni muda gani itachukua kwenda mara 6?
problem_en: It takes 20 minutes for John to go to the bathroom 8 times.  How long would it take to go 6 times?
solution:
He spends 20/8=2.5 minutes each time he goes in
So it would take 2.5*6=15 minutes to go 6 times
The final answer is \boxed{15}.

problem_swa: Max anahitaji sahani 65 za karatasi kwa ajili ya karamu ya barbeque. Tayari ana sahani 22 za karatasi ya kijani na sahani 24 za karatasi ya bluu. Anahitaji sahani nyingine ngapi za karatasi?
problem_en: Max needs 65 paper plates for the barbecue party.  He already has 22 green paper plates and 24 blue paper plates. How many more paper plates does he need?
solution:
He already has a total of 22 + 24 = 46 paper plates.
Therefore, Max needs 65 - 46 = 19 more paper plates.
The final answer is \boxed{19}.

problem_swa: Hakeem daima alipenda mchuzi wa artichoke na ana mpango wa kuufanya mwishoni mwa wiki hii. Ana dola 15 za kununua artichoke na anaweza kupata viungo vingine nyumbani. Inachukua artichokes 3 kufanya 5 ounces ya kuzamisha. Anaweza kutengeneza gramu ngapi ikiwa kila artichoke inagharimu dola 1.25?
problem_en: Hakeem has always loved artichoke dip and plans to make it this weekend. He has $15 dollars to buy artichokes and can find the rest of the ingredients at home. It takes 3 artichokes to make 5 ounces of dip. How many ounces can he make if artichokes cost $1.25 each?
solution:
He can buy 12 artichokes because 15 / 1.25 = 12
Each artichoke makes 5/3 ounces of dip because there are 3 artichokes per 5 ounces
He can make 20 ounces of dip because 12 x (5/3) = 60/3 = 20
The final answer is \boxed{20}.

problem_swa: Mary anaona mipira mitatu ya kuzaa yenye nyoka 8 kila mmoja na jozi 6 zaidi za nyoka. Aliona nyoka wangapi kwa jumla?
problem_en: Mary sees three breeding balls with 8 snakes each and 6 additional pairs of snakes. How many snakes did she see total?
solution:
First find how many snakes were in all the breeding balls: 3 balls * 8 snakes/ball = 24 snakes
Then find how many snakes are in all the pairs: 2 snakes/pair * 6 pairs = 12 snakes
Then add the number of snakes in both types of groups to find the total number of snakes: 24 snakes + 12 snakes = 36 snakes
The final answer is \boxed{36}.

problem_swa: Kimbunga kinakaribia pwani ya kusini ya Texas, na mkulima wa mifugo anapanga kuhamisha ng'ombe 400 kilometa 60 hadi mahali palipoinuka ili kuwalinda kutokana na mafuriko yanayoweza kutokea. Lori lake la kusafirisha wanyama hubeba ng'ombe 20. Kusafiri kwa 60 maili kwa saa, nini jumla ya wakati wa kuendesha gari, katika masaa, itachukua kusafirisha ng'ombe wake wote kwa ardhi ya juu?
problem_en: A hurricane is approaching the southern coast of Texas, and a rancher is planning to move 400 head of cattle 60 miles to higher ground to protect them from possible inland flooding that might occur.  His animal transport truck holds 20 head of cattle.  Traveling at 60 miles per hour, what is the total driving time, in hours, it will take to transport all of his cattle to higher ground?
solution:
Given the limited capacity of his transport vehicle (20 head of cattle), the 400 head of cattle will require 400/20=20 trips using his transport vehicle.
Traveling to the site at 60 mph for 60 miles it will take 60/60=1 hour to travel one-way.
Since each trip requires driving to and returning from the relocation site, each complete round trip will take 2*1=2 hours.
Thus, 20 complete trips will take 20*2=40 hours of driving time.
The final answer is \boxed{40}.

problem_swa: Kama Lyn anatoa $240 kwa shirika binafsi kila mwaka ambapo 1/3 yake huenda kwa mradi pantry jamii, 1/2 huenda kwa mfuko wa mgogoro wa ndani, 1/4 ya iliyobaki huenda kwa fedha mradi maisha, na wengine ni kwa ajili ya fedha ya dharura. Ni kiasi gani kinaenda kwenye mfuko wa dharura?
problem_en: If Lyn donates $240 to a private organization each year where 1/3 of it goes to the community pantry project, 1/2 goes to the local crisis fund, 1/4 of the remaining goes to livelihood project funds, and the rest is for contingency funds. How much goes to contingency fund?
solution:
The community pantry project gets 240 x 1/3 = $80.
The local crisis fund has 240 x 1/2 = $120.
The total funds allocated for the two funds is $80 + $120 = $200.
So, $240 - $200 = $40 are left for the other 2 funds.
The livelihood project gets $40 x 1/4 = $10.
This means that the contingency fund is $40 - $10 = $30.
The final answer is \boxed{30}.

problem_swa: Kiwanda cha kuoka mikate kilitengeneza muffin 95. Zitapakiwa katika masanduku yenye muffin 5 katika kila sanduku. Ikiwa kuna masanduku 10 tu yanayopatikana, bado wanahitaji masanduku mangapi ya kupakia muffins zote?
problem_en: The bakery made 95 muffins. They will be packed in boxes with 5 muffins in each box. If there are only 10 available boxes, how many boxes do they still need to pack all the muffins?
solution:
A total of 10 x 5 = 50 muffins will be packed in 10 boxes.
So 95 - 50 = 45 muffins still need to be packed in the boxes.
Thus, 45/5 = 9 boxes are still needed to pack all those 45 muffins.
The final answer is \boxed{9}.

problem_swa: Nywele za John hukua kwa sentimeta 1.5 kila mwezi. Kila mara inapofikia urefu wa inchi 9 yeye hupunguza hadi inchi 6. Kunyoa nywele kunagharimu dola 45 naye hutoa 20% ya bakshishi. Yeye hutumia pesa ngapi kwa kukata nywele kwa mwaka?
problem_en: John's hair grows 1.5 inches every month.  Every time it gets to 9 inches long he cuts it down to 6 inches.  A haircut costs $45 and he gives a 20% tip.  How much does he spend on haircuts a year?
solution:
He cuts off 9-6=3 inches when he gets a haircut
That means he needs to cut it every 3/1.5=2 months
So he gets 12/2=6 haircuts a year
He gives a 45*.2=$9 tip
So that means each hair cut cost 45+9=$54
So he pays 54*6=$324 a year
The final answer is \boxed{324}.

problem_swa: Anna anapika keki za tangawizi. Yeye huwapa 6 kati yao kofia nyekundu, 9 kati yao buti za bluu, na 3 kati yao kofia nyekundu na buti za bluu. Ni asilimia ngapi ya wanaume wa gingerbread wana kofia nyekundu?
problem_en: Anna is making gingerbread cookies. She gives 6 of them red hats, 9 of them blue boots, and 3 of them both red hats and blue boots. What percentage of the gingerbread men have red hats?
solution:
The first step to find the total number of gingerbread men is to add the number with each decoration: 6 men + 9 men = 15 men
Then subtract the number of gingerbread men with both decorations to find the total number of gingerbread men: 15 men - 3 men = 12 men
Then divide the number of gingerbread men with red hats by the total number and multiply by 100% to express the answer as a percentage: 6 men / 12 men * 100% = 50%
The final answer is \boxed{50}.

problem_swa: Duka la keki hulipa dola tano kwa kipande cha keki. Wao hukata kila keki nzima katika vipande 4. Duka la keki litapata pesa ngapi ikiwa watauza keki 9?
problem_en: A pie shop charges $5 for a slice of pie. They cut each whole pie into 4 slices. How much money will the pie shop make if they sell 9 pies?
solution:
A pie contains 4 slices so the pie shop makes 5*4=$20 for a pie.
If they sell 9 pies, they make 9*20=$180
The final answer is \boxed{180}.

problem_swa: Olivia analipa senti 4 kwa chips na senti 12 kwa soda. Yeye hulipa jumla ya dola ngapi?
problem_en: Olivia pays 4 quarters for chips and 12 quarters for soda. How many dollars does she pay in total?
solution:
4 quarters equals to 4 / 4 = $1.
12 quarters equals to 12 / 4= $3.
She pays 1 + 3 = $4 in total.
The final answer is \boxed{4}.

problem_swa: Ben hufanya sandwich ambayo ina jumla ya kalori 1250 ambayo ina vipande viwili vya nyama ya nguruwe na kalori 125 kila moja. Ni asilimia ngapi ya jumla ya kalori ya sandwichi inayotokana na nyama ya nguruwe?
problem_en: Ben makes a sandwich that has 1250 calories total that has two strips of bacon with 125 calories each. What percentage of the sandwich's total calories come from bacon?
solution:
First find the total number of calories in the bacon: 125 calories + 125 calories = 250 calories
Then divide the number of bacon calories by the total number of calories and multiply by 100% to express the answer as a percentage: 250 calories / 1250 calories * 100% = 20%
The final answer is \boxed{20}.

problem_swa: Kuna washiriki wanne katika nyumba moja. Kila mshiriki hula vipande 3 vya mkate wakati wa kiamsha kinywa na vipande 2 vya mkate wakati wa chakula cha mchana. Mkate mmoja una vipande 12. Ni siku ngapi mikate mitano itatosha katika familia hii?
problem_en: There are four members in one household. Each member consumes 3 slices of bread during breakfast and 2 slices of bread for snacks. A loaf of bread has 12 slices. How many days will five loaves of bread last in this family?
solution:
A total of 3 + 2 = 5 slices of bread are consumed by each member every day.
So a family consumes a total of 5 x 4 = 20 slices of bread every day.
Five loaves of bread have 5 x 12 = 60 slices of bread.
Thus, the 5 loaves of bread last for 60/20 = 3 days.
The final answer is \boxed{3}.

problem_swa: Andy anafanya kazi katika duka la michezo ya tenisi, ambapo anapata dola 9 kwa saa. Kwa kuongezea hili, yeye hulipiwa dola 15 kwa kila raketi anayoshikilia, dola 10 kwa kubadilisha grommets kwenye raketi, na dola moja kwa kuchora stencil kwenye kamba za raketi. Yeye hupata kiasi gani (kabla ya kulipa kodi) katika zamu ya saa 8 ikiwa anashona mikongojo 7, anabadilisha seti 2 za mikongojo, na kupaka rangi stensil 5?
problem_en: Andy works in the pro shop at a tennis resort, where he earns $9 an hour. In addition to this, he gets paid $15 for each racquet he restrings, $10 for changing out the grommets on a racquet, and $1 for painting a stencil on the racquet strings. How much does he earn (before taxes) during an 8-hour shift if he strings 7 racquets, changes 2 sets of grommets, and paints 5 stencils?
solution:
Andy works 8 hours, so he earns a wage of 8 hours * $9 per hour = $72 just for working there.
During that time, he restrings 7 racquets, so he earns 7 racquets * $15 per racquet = $105 from stringing.
He also changed the grommets in 2 of those racquets, so he earned 2 grommet jobs * $10 per grommet job = $20 from changing grommets.
And he stenciled 5 racquets, so he earned 5 stencil jobs * $1 per stencil job = $5 for stenciling.
In total, Andy earned $72 + $105 + $20 + 5 = $202 for the day.
The final answer is \boxed{202}.

problem_swa: Kwa sababu ya uhamaji wa salmoni, jumla ya idadi ya salmoni katika mto Trout imeongezeka mara kumi kuliko idadi ya awali katika mto huo. Ikiwa mwanzoni kulikuwa na samoni 500, hesabu idadi ya samaki katika mto huo sasa.
problem_en: Because of the migration of salmon, the total number of salmon in river Trout has increased by ten times the number initially in the river. If there were 500 salmons initially, calculate the total number of fish in the river now.
solution:
If the number of salmons in the river increased by ten times the number initially there, then 500*10 = 5000 new salmons migrated up the river.
The total number of salmon in the river now is 5000+500 = 5500
The final answer is \boxed{5500}.

problem_swa: Dikembe anataka kufundisha kila mtu shuleni umuhimu wa kutumia uzi, kwa hiyo anapanga kuleta vifurushi vya uzi vya kutosha kwa kila mtu. Kuna wanafunzi 20 darasani mwake. Kila mwanafunzi anahitaji uzi wenye urefu wa meta 1.5. Aona katika duka kwamba kila kifurushi cha uzi wa mkononi kina meta 35. Ikiwa yeye hununua kiasi kidogo zaidi kinachohitajiwa, ni uzi kiasi gani unaobaki?
problem_en: Dikembe wants to teach everyone at school about the importance of flossing, so he plans to bring enough packets of floss for everyone. There are 20 students in his class. Each student needs 1.5 yards of floss. He sees in the store that each packet of floss contains 35 yards. If he buys the least amount necessary, how much floss is left over?
solution:
He will need to bring 30 yards of floss because 20 x 1.5 = 30
One packet of floss is enough because 35 > 30
He has 5 yards left over because 35 - 30 = 5
The final answer is \boxed{5}.

problem_swa: Jake hupata mara tatu ya kile ambacho Jacob hupata. Kama Jacob anapata dola 6 kwa saa, Jake anapata kiasi gani kwa siku 5 akifanya kazi saa 8 kwa siku?
problem_en: Jake earns thrice what Jacob does. If Jacob earns $6 per hour, how much does Jake earn in 5 days working 8 hours a day?
solution:
Jake earns $6 * 3 = $18 per hour.
Working, 8 hour in a day, he earns $18 * 8 = $144.
So in 5 days, Jake earns $144 x 5 = $720.
The final answer is \boxed{720}.

problem_swa: Basi la shule lilitembea kwa dakika 42 kwa mwendo wa kilometa 50 kwa saa. Ni umbali gani ambao basi hilo lilitembea katika maili?
problem_en: A school bus traveled for 42 minutes at a speed of 50 mph. What is the distance the bus traveled in miles?
solution:
1 hour = 60 minutes.
We convert the time to hours, so 42 minutes = 42/60 hours = 7/10 hours.
So in 42 minutes, the distance the bus traveled in miles is 50 * (7/10) = 35 miles.
The final answer is \boxed{35}.

problem_swa: Idadi ya Oreos na biskuti katika sanduku ni katika uwiano wa 4:9. Zane alinunua kila Oreo kwa dola 2 na kila biskuti kwa dola 3. Zane alitumia pesa ngapi kununua biskuti kuliko kununua Oreos ikiwa jumla ya vitu katika sanduku ni 65?
problem_en: The number of Oreos and cookies in a box is in the ratio 4:9. Zane bought each Oreo at $2 and each cookie at $3. How much more money did Zane spend on buying the cookies than buying the Oreos if the total number of items in the box is 65?
solution:
The total ratio representing the number of cookies and Oreos that Zack bought is 4+9=13
The fraction representing the number of Oreos Zane bought is 4/13, and since the total number of items in the box is 65, Zane bought 4/13*65=20 Oreos.
If Zane bought 20 Oreos at $2 each, the total cost of buying Oreos is $2*20=$40
Since the total number of items in the box is 65, and there are 20 Oreos in the box, the number of cookies in the box is 65-20=45
The cost of buying the cookies at $3 each is 45*$3=$135
If the Oreos cost $40 to buy, Zane used $135-$40=$95 more to buy Cookies than Oreos.
The final answer is \boxed{95}.

problem_swa: Jenny hufanya na kufungia sufuria za lasagna juma zima ili aweze kuziuza sokoni mwishoni mwa juma. Jenny hutumia dola 10.00 kwa viungo ili kutengeneza sufuria moja ya lasagna. Ikiwa yeye hufanya na kuuza sufuria 20 mwishoni mwa juma kwa dola 25.00 kila moja, yeye hufanya kiasi gani baada ya kuhesabu gharama?
problem_en: Jenny makes and freezes pans of lasagna all week so she can sell them at the market on the weekend.  It costs Jenny $10.00 in ingredients to make 1 pan of lasagna.  If she makes and sells 20 pans over the weekend at $25.00 apiece, how much does she make after factoring in expenses?
solution:
Each pan costs $10.00 to make so for 20 pans, it will cost 10*20 = $200.00
She sells each of the 20 pans for $25.00 each so she will make 20*25 = $500.00
She makes $500.00 and spent $200.00 on ingredients so she makes 500-200 = $300.00
The final answer is \boxed{300}.

problem_swa: Donna alifanya kazi saa 2 kila asubuhi akitembea na mbwa katika ujirani wake kwa dola 10.00 kwa saa. Siku 5 kwa juma, baada ya shule, alifanya kazi katika duka la kadi kwa muda wa saa 2 na kupata dola 12.50 kwa saa. Mwishoni mwa juma, kwa kawaida alilipwa dola 10.00 kwa saa ya kutunza watoto na alihakikishiwa saa 4 kila Jumamosi kutoka kwa jirani yake. Alipata pesa ngapi kwa siku saba?
problem_en: Donna worked 2 hours every morning walking dogs in her neighborhood for $10.00 an hour.  5 days a week, after school, she worked at a card shop for 2 hours and made $12.50 an hour.  On the weekends, she usually made $10.00 an hour babysitting and was guaranteed 4 hours every Saturday from her neighbor.  How much money did she make over 7 days?
solution:
She makes $10.00 an hour for 2 hours walking dogs so she makes 10*2 = $20.00 every morning
Over 7 days she makes 7*20 = $140.00 a week
She makes $12.50 for 2 hours working at a card shop so she makes 12.5*2 = $25.00
She works there 5 days a week so she makes 5*25 = $125.00 a week
She also babysits for 4 hours making $10.00 an hour for a total of 4*10 = $40.00
Over 7 days, she makes 140+125+40 = $305.00
The final answer is \boxed{305}.

problem_swa: Vikapu vitatu A, B na C vina idadi tofauti ya marumaru ya rangi tofauti. Kikapu A kina vidonge 4 vyekundu na vidonge 2 vya manjano. Kikapu B kina vidonge 6 vya kijani na kidonge 1 cha manjano. Kikapu C kina vidonge 3 vyeupe na vidonge 9 vya manjano. Ni tofauti gani kati ya idadi ya kila rangi ya marumaru katika kikapu ambayo ina tofauti kubwa?
problem_en: Three baskets A, B and C contain different numbers of differently colored marbles. Basket A contains 4 red marbles and 2 yellow marbles. Basket B contains 6 green marbles and 1 yellow marble. Basket C contains 3 white marbles and 9 yellow marbles. What is the difference between the number of each color of marble in the basket that has the greatest difference?
solution:
In basket A the number difference between differently colored marbles is 4-2 = 2
In basket B the difference is 6-1 = 5
In basket C the difference is 9-3 = 6
Comparing 2, 5 and 6 shows that 6 is the greatest difference
The final answer is \boxed{6}.

problem_swa: Baada ya Betty kumpa Stuart asilimia 40 ya mkusanyiko wake wa marumaru, idadi ya marumaru katika mkusanyiko wa Stuart iliongezeka hadi 80. Ikiwa Betty alikuwa na vidonge 60, Stuart alikuwa na vidonge vingapi mwanzoni?
problem_en: After Betty gave Stuart 40% of her marble collection, the number of marbles in Stuart's collection increased to 80. If Betty had 60 marbles, how many marbles did Stuart have initially?
solution:
If Betty had 60 marbles, she gave Stuart 40/100*60=24 marbles.
Since the number of marbles in Stuart's collection increased to 80 after Betty gave him 24 marbles, the number of marbles he initially had is 80-24=56
The final answer is \boxed{56}.

problem_swa: Kama Pete kusoma vitabu mara mbili kama Matt alifanya mwaka jana, na mwaka huu yeye mara mbili kwamba idadi wakati Matt anasoma tu 50% zaidi, vitabu ngapi Pete kusoma katika miaka miwili kama Matt kusoma vitabu 75 katika mwaka wake wa pili?
problem_en: If Pete read twice as many books as Matt did last year, and this year he doubles that number while Matt reads only 50% more, how many books does Pete read across both years if Matt read 75 books in his second year?
solution:
First, we need to find the amount Matt read both years to establish what Pete read, so to find Matt's first-year total we multiply 75 / 1.5 = 50 books the previous year.
Since Pete read twice as many books as Matt did in the first year, and Matt's first-year total is 50, this means Pete read 50*2=100 books his first year.
Since Pete doubled the number of books he read the following year, this means Pete read 100*2=200 books the following year.
We add the two years of Pete's reading together to find 200+100=300 books read in total.
The final answer is \boxed{300}.

problem_swa: Mikail ana siku ya kuzaliwa kesho. Atakuwa mzee mara tatu kuliko alipokuwa na umri wa miaka mitatu. Katika siku yake ya kuzaliwa, wazazi wake humpa dola 5 kwa kila mwaka anaokuwa na umri. Watampa pesa ngapi?
problem_en: Mikail's birthday is tomorrow. He will be 3 times older than he was when he was three. On his birthday, his parents give him $5 for every year old he is. How much money will they give him?
solution:
Mikail is 9 because 3 x 3 = 9
He will get $45 because 9 x $5 = $45
The final answer is \boxed{45}.

problem_swa: Grant ana likizo mara nne kuliko Kelvin ana madarasa. Ikiwa Kelvin ana madarasa 90, Grant na Kelvin wana likizo na madarasa mangapi kwa jumla?
problem_en: Grant has four times as many vacations as Kelvin has classes. If Kelvin has 90 classes, how many vacations and classes do Grant and Kelvin have altogether?
solution:
Grant has 4*90 = 360 vacations.
In total, they have 360 + 90 = 450 vacations and classes.
The final answer is \boxed{450}.

problem_swa: Max hujaza puto za maji kwa dakika 30 kwa kiwango cha puto 2 za maji kila dakika. Rafiki ya Max Zach hujaza puto za maji kwa muda wa dakika 40 kwa kiwango cha puto 3 za maji kila dakika. Katika mchakato huo, baluni 10 za maji huanguka ardhini. Max na Zach wana jumla ya puto ngapi zilizojaa maji?
problem_en: Max fills up water balloons for 30 minutes at a rate of 2 water balloons every minute. Max’s friend Zach fills up water balloons for 40 minutes at a rate of 3 water balloons every minute. In the process, 10 of the water balloons pop on the ground. How many filled water balloons do Max and Zach have in total?
solution:
Max fills 30 * 2 = 60 water balloons
Zach fills 40 * 3 = 120 water balloons
Max and Zach have a total of 60 + 120 - 10 = 170 water balloons
The final answer is \boxed{170}.
